title_translated: MUCnoHARM@GermEval共享任务2026：基于检索的上下文学习在诽谤性犯罪检测中的应用及其局限
summary_translated: 仇恨言论在网络中普遍存在，自动检测至关重要，尤其是在涉及刑事相关社交媒体内容时。我们研究了多种基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL）策略在检测§§185-187 StGB（GermEval 2026子任务4的主题）所规定的诽谤性犯罪中的表现。少样本提示优于零样本，但基于检索的方法仅带来微弱收益，甚至不如优化后的静态示例集。提供具体的法律知识有所帮助，但模型选择远超其他系统选择的影响。模型存在过度预测刑事相关性的问题，同时仍遗漏26%-57%的刑事相关帖子，因此更适合用于初步筛选而非自主管理。

summary: Long-term language-model agents rely on external memory across interactions. Atomic memories are particularly useful: their fine-grained semantic boundaries enable precise retrieval and direct comparison between observations. Yet accumulating atoms inevitably become redundant, overlapping, or conflicting. Existing methods often ask an LLM manager to add, update, delete, or rewrite memories directly, coupling semantic interpretation, storage decisions, and content generation in one error-prone operation. We introduce ROAM, a relation-guided framework that uses atomicity for management while allowing richer answer-time representations. ROAM classifies incoming--stored atom pairs as independent, equivalent, directionally subsuming, or conflicting, then organizes observations into active Primary and supporting Evidence roles. Fusion subsequently combines complementary details and temporal changes into compact, potentially non-atomic views. Only Primary views are retrieved for answering, preventing redundant or outdated atoms from competing independently. Across models and evaluation settings, ROAM improves answer accuracy by up to 29.8 percentage points. Ablations show complementary benefits from different relations and consistent gains from fusion beyond role organization. Mechanism analysis further finds 15.6-point higher answer-critical source recall and an 11.5-point lower confounder-token share. ROAM remains robust across manager scales.
title: ROAM: Robust Organization of Atomic Memories for Agents through Semantic Relations
title_translated: ROAM：通过语义关系实现智能体原子记忆的鲁棒组织
summary_translated: 长期语言模型智能体依赖跨交互的外部记忆。原子记忆特别有用：其细粒度的语义边界支持精确检索并允许直接比较观察结果。然而，积累的原子记忆不可避免地变得冗余、重叠或冲突。现有方法通常让LLM管理者直接执行添加、更新、删除或重写记忆操作，将语义理解、存储决策与内容生成耦合在一个易出错的流程中。我们提出ROAM，一种基于关系引导的框架，利用原子性进行管理，同时支持更丰富的回答时表示。ROAM将新输入与已有原子对分类为独立、等价、方向包含或冲突，然后将观察结果组织为活跃的主记忆和辅助证据角色。融合步骤随后将互补细节和时间变化整合为紧凑的、可能非原子化的视图。仅主视图用于回答，防止冗余或过时原子独立竞争。在多种模型和评估设置下，ROAM将回答准确率提升最高达29.8个百分点。消融实验显示不同关系带来的互补优势，以及融合机制在角色组织之外的持续增益。机制分析进一步发现，关键信息源召回率提高15.6点，混淆词占比降低11.5点。ROAM在不同管理者规模下均保持鲁棒性。

summary: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture. Extending V1's spike-gated dual paths, it adds graded signed events at further projections and softmax-free local attention. We implement the 194M-parameter model on an Alveo U50C FPGA using digital fixed-point arithmetic and on an ARM CPU using sparse integer execution. Across three same-checkpoint FPGA implementations at 175 MHz, active-row weight gathering and valid-state KV loading raise decode throughput from 474.6 to 643.2 tokens/s for a 32-token prefix and 128 outputs. Estimated gross card energy falls from 0.06087 to 0.04407 J per generated token, a 27.6% reduction. Complete-request energy, including prefill, falls by 24.4-27.7% across three prefix lengths. An independent idle split attributes 82.8% of gross card energy to loaded idle, explaining the benefit of shorter token latency. Against the recorded RTX 5090 compiled-FP32 baseline, integer FPGA execution uses 89.1% less estimated card energy during short-context decode; arithmetic precisions differ, and the GPU baseline is not the lowest-energy tested configuration. On four Cortex-A76 cores of a ROCK 5T, complete requests reach 65.4 tokens/s at 9.80 W and 0.151 J per generated token at the adapter's AC input. These results connect event sparsity to omitted computation and data movement. The mechanisms also support other dedicated V2 implementations: increasing throughput by a greater factor than active power lowers energy per generated token. Evaluation holds the deployed checkpoint fixed; its quality trails a same-budget dense control, so the results do not establish equal-quality efficiency.
title: SymbolicLight V2: Hybrid Neuromorphic Architecture and Sparse Execution for Low-Energy Language Inference
title_translated: SymbolicLight V2：面向低功耗语言推理的混合类脑架构与稀疏执行
summary_translated: SymbolicLight V2 将稀疏事件计算与连续状态处理结合，构建了一种混合类脑语言架构。在V1的脉冲门控双路径基础上，新增了分级有符号事件及无softmax局部注意力机制。我们使用数字定点算术在Alveo U50C FPGA上实现了1.94亿参数模型，并在ARM CPU上采用稀疏整数执行。在三个相同检查点的FPGA实现中，工作行权重聚合和有效状态KV加载使32个前缀token和128个输出的解码吞吐量从474.6提升至643.2 tokens/s。每生成一个token的总卡级能耗从0.06087降至0.04407 J，降低27.6%。包含预填充的完整请求能耗在三种前缀长度下降低了24.4%-27.7%。独立空闲拆分分析表明，82.8%的总卡级能耗来自已加载但空闲的状态，解释了较短token延迟的优势。与记录的RTX 5090编译FP32基线相比，整数FPGA执行在短上下文解码期间节省了89.1%的估算卡级能耗；尽管精度不同，且GPU基线并非测试中最低能耗配置。在ROCK 5T的四个Cortex-A76核心上，完整请求达到65.4 tokens/s，功耗为9.80 W，每生成一个token消耗0.151 J（适配器交流输入）。这些结果将事件稀疏性与被省略的计算和数据移动联系起来。该机制也支持其他专用V2实现：通过比活跃功耗下降更大的因子提升吞吐量，从而降低每生成token的能耗。评估保持部署检查点不变；其性能落后于同预算的密集控制模型，因此结果未建立同等质量下的效率优势。

summary: Churn models typically identify high-risk customers but do not specify which feasible retention action should be considered or why that action is appropriate. We present CARRE (Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation), a three-stage framework that combines retrieval-augmented candidate generation, cost-aware counterfactual scoring, and large language model (LLM) reasoning. CARRE retrieves a predefined catalog of retention actions, estimates model-predicted churn-risk changes under explicit feature transformations, and generates a structured churn reason and a profile-grounded explanation for the selected action. On the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset, CARRE achieves 79.8% greater mean model-predicted risk reduction than the plain SHAP baseline and 80.4% greater reduction than the cost-controlled SHAP+Cost baseline across 313 high-risk test cases; its cost-normalized efficiency is 10.5% higher than that of plain SHAP. On a 136-case reason-stratified evaluation sample, diagnosis-driven prompt refinement increases weak-label agreement from 79.4% to 90.4%, with no auxiliary-plan constraint violations; because the same sample was used for error diagnosis and re-evaluation, the post-refinement result is not an independent estimate of generalization. For 135 explanations generated using the pre-refinement v2 reason outputs, two cross-vendor LLM judges assign mean scores ranging from 4.02 to 5.00 out of 5, although one judge saturates on actionability, and a deterministic audit finds no contradictions among 66 verifiable profile claims. Retrieval ablations show that k=5 provides the best evaluated compromise between high candidate coverage and downstream reasoning agreement in this dataset. These results illustrate how retrieval, model-based counterfactual scoring, and language generation can be separated and jointly evaluated in a prototype churn-prescription pipeline.
title: CARRE: Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation for Explainable Churn Prescription

title_translated: CARRE：用于可解释流失预测的反事实动作检索与推理评估
summary_translated: 流失模型通常能识别高风险客户，但无法明确应考虑哪些可行的保留动作及其合理性。我们提出CARRE（反事实动作检索与推理评估）框架，包含三个阶段：基于检索的候选生成、成本感知的反事实评分以及大语言模型（LLM）推理。CARRE从预定义的保留动作目录中检索动作，估计在显式特征变换下模型预测的流失风险变化，并生成结构化的流失原因及基于用户画像的解释。在IBM电信客户流失数据集上，CARRE在313个高风险测试案例中，平均模型预测风险降低幅度比普通SHAP基线高出79.8%，比成本控制的SHAP+Cost基线高出80.4%；其成本归一化效率比普通SHAP高出10.5%。在136例按原因分层的评估样本中，基于诊断的提示优化使弱标签一致性从79.4%提升至90.4%，且未违反辅助计划约束；由于同一样本用于错误诊断和重新评估，优化后结果并非泛化能力的独立估计。对135条使用预优化v2原因输出生成的解释，两名跨厂商LLM评委给出的平均得分在4.02至5.00之间（满分5分），尽管一名评委在可操作性维度出现饱和；确定性审计发现66个可验证的用户画像陈述中无矛盾。检索消融实验显示，在该数据集中k=5在高候选覆盖率与下游推理一致性之间提供了最佳权衡。这些结果展示了如何将检索、基于模型的反事实评分与语言生成分离，并在原型流失预测流程中联合评估。

summary: Social intelligence enables agents to read social context, infer intent, and adapt over sustained dialogue. As language models become autonomous collaborators, it is central to building effective and trustworthy human-AI interaction. Existing reinforcement learning methods optimize single-turn utterances and sparse outcome rewards, producing short-sighted policies that struggle to manage goal-relationship tensions across multi-turn interactions. We propose SocialRL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework addressing both challenges. First, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning using PPO that propagates delayed outcome rewards back to each turn, enabling long-horizon planning. Second, we design six process reward dimensions capturing the goal-relationship trade-off, including goal advancement, relational attunement, contextual coherence, etc. A reward model dynamically generates fine-grained scoring criteria for each dimension, while a stage-aware weight schedule prioritizes relationship-building in early turns, goal advancement mid-way, and balanced closure late. Across multiple social-dialogue benchmarks, SocialRL improves Goal Achievement by an average of 9.2 percentage points over the corresponding Base models. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SocialRL across synthetic and real social scenes, as well as standard and challenging social scenarios.
title: SocialRL: Refining LLMs' Social Intelligence through Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning and Reward Design
title_translated: SocialRL：通过多轮强化学习与奖励设计提升LLM的社会智能
summary_translated: 社会智能使代理能够理解社交情境、推断意图并持续适应对话。随着语言模型成为自主协作伙伴，构建高效可信的人机交互至关重要。现有强化学习方法仅优化单轮话语和稀疏结果奖励，导致短视策略难以在多轮互动中平衡目标与关系张力。我们提出SocialRL，一种解决上述两个挑战的多轮强化学习框架。首先，采用PPO进行多轮强化学习，将延迟的结果奖励回传至每一回合，支持长时程规划。其次，设计六维过程奖励以捕捉目标-关系权衡，包括目标推进、关系契合度、语境连贯性等。奖励模型动态生成各维度的细粒度评分标准，而阶段感知的权重调度则在早期回合优先关系建设，中期侧重目标推进，后期实现平衡收尾。在多个社交对话基准测试中，SocialRL相较对应基础模型平均提升目标达成率9.2个百分点。这些结果证明了SocialRL在合成与真实社交场景、标准与挑战性社交任务中的有效性。

summary: Text-aligned speech tokenization methods have emerged to better align speech tokens with LLM token spaces, enabling more effective utilization of pretrained LLMs. However, they rely on offline automatic speech recognition (ASR), leading to two key limitations: (i) the need for complete utterances before tokenization, precluding real-time streaming, and (ii) vocabulary mismatch between ASR and LLMs, which reduces acoustic granularity from the subword to the word level. We introduce StreamAlign, a text-aligned speech tokenization framework that enables streaming tokenization for real-time speech-text joint modeling. StreamAlign performs online speech-text alignment by combining character-level RNN-Transducer alignment with word-level ASR guidance, mitigating ASR-LLM vocabulary mismatch while preserving recognition accuracy. A proactive word boundary classifier anticipates word completion at chunk boundaries, reducing tokenization latency from 560 ms to 270 ms. On LibriSpeech, StreamAlign achieves the lowest WER and highest UTMOS among evaluated tokenizers. Furthermore, StreamAlign-SLM, a spoken language model trained on StreamAlign units, outperforms other end-to-end spoken language models in speech continuation while achieving the strongest overall consistency on SALMon and spoken StoryCloze.
title: StreamAlign: Streaming Text-Aligned Speech Tokenization

title_translated: StreamAlign：流式文本对齐语音标记化
summary_translated: 文本对齐语音标记化方法近年来兴起，旨在更好地将语音标记与语言模型标记空间对齐，从而更有效地利用预训练语言模型。然而，这些方法依赖离线自动语音识别（ASR），带来两个关键局限：(i) 必须等待完整语句才能开始标记化，无法实现实时流式处理；(ii) ASR与语言模型之间的词汇不匹配，导致声学粒度从子词级别退化到词级别。我们提出StreamAlign，一种支持实时语音-文本联合建模的流式标记化框架。StreamAlign通过结合字符级RNN-Transducer对齐与词级ASR引导，实现在线语音-文本对齐，在缓解ASR-LLM词汇不匹配的同时保持识别准确率。一个主动的词边界分类器可在块边界提前预测词完成，将标记化延迟从560 ms降低至270 ms。在LibriSpeech数据集上，StreamAlign在所有评估标记化器中实现了最低的WER和最高的UTMOS。此外，基于StreamAlign单元训练的语音语言模型StreamAlign-SLM，在语音续写任务中优于其他端到端语音语言模型，并在SALMon和语音StoryCloze任务上表现出最强的整体一致性。

summary: Customers rely on specific product attributes to compare products and make purchasing decisions, but e-commerce catalogs are messy and unstructured, making it difficult to identify which attributes matter most and extract them at scale. Standard Attribute Value Extraction (AVE) systems treat all attributes equally, producing large, inconsistent attribute sets that do not reflect the factors consumers use to differentiate products. We introduce a two-stage LLM pipeline that first discovers a compact, ranked schema of purchase-discriminative attributes for each product category, then extracts their values from catalog text using a fine-tuned compact LLM (Qwen3-4B) with Hyper-Parallel Decoding (HPD). This pipeline achieves 85% extraction accuracy, on par with the foundational LLM it was distilled from, while reducing inference costs by 92% over foundational LLMs, enabling production-scale use for product discovery and catalog enrichment. The resulting category-level structured representations effectively constitute automatically constructed product knowledge bases, providing consistent, comparable attributes across varied product categories that can ground downstream knowledge-intensive applications.
title: Scaling E-Commerce Attribute Extraction with Parallel Decoding

title_translated: 通过并行解码实现电商属性提取的规模化
summary_translated: 消费者依赖特定产品属性来比较商品并做出购买决策，但电商平台目录混乱且非结构化，难以识别哪些属性最重要并大规模提取。标准属性值提取（AVE）系统对所有属性一视同仁，产生庞大且不一致的属性集合，无法反映消费者区分产品的实际因素。我们引入一个两阶段LLM流水线：首先为每个产品类别发现紧凑且排序的购买区分性属性模式，然后使用微调后的紧凑LLM（Qwen3-4B）结合超并行解码（HPD）从目录文本中提取属性值。该流水线在提取准确率上达到85%，与所蒸馏的基础LLM相当，同时相比基础LLM将推理成本降低92%，实现了产品发现与目录增强的生产级应用。由此生成的类别级结构化表示有效构成了自动构建的产品知识库，提供跨多样化产品类别的统一、可比属性，可为下游知识密集型应用提供支撑。

summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as automated auditors of document quality, yet their reliability as detectors of planted errors is poorly characterised. We construct a contaminated corpus of 150 academic papers spanning supply chain management and medical research, injecting 450 known contaminants of three types: typographical corruption, semantic reversal, and absurd out-of-context insertion. We then evaluate Google Gemini 3.0 Pro's ability to recover a 180-contaminant answer-key subset across 60 documents under three prompting regimes of increasing scale: single document, small batch, and large batch. Detection holds at small scale and then collapses: 50% recovery on single documents, 60% on small batches, and 2.8% on large batches. The failure mode at scale is not abstention but fabrication. Rather than reporting incomplete processing, the model produced confident findings including invented contaminants of its own, absurdities such as "telepathic squirrel" and "quantum-powered toaster" that mimic the style of the planted material but do not appear in any document. Detection also varies by contamination type: absurd insertions were recovered at 75% in completed evaluations, while semantic reversals and typographical corruptions were each recovered at only 50%. The corruptions most likely to occur in the wild, plausible ones, are the ones most often missed. We conclude that LLM document auditing degrades not gracefully but deceptively, and outline the harness such systems require: bounded batch sizes, direct content injection, and mechanical verification of every reported finding against source text.
title: When Auditors Fabricate: Batch-Size Degradation and Confident Hallucination in LLM Detection of Planted Document Contamination

title_translated: 当审计员造假时：大语言模型在检测植入文档污染中的批量大小退化与自信幻觉
summary_translated: 大型语言模型被越来越多地提议作为文档质量的自动化审计工具，但其在检测植入错误方面的可靠性尚未得到充分评估。我们构建了一个包含150篇涵盖供应链管理和医学研究的学术论文的污染语料库，注入了三种类型的450个已知污染：拼写错误、语义反转和不合逻辑的上下文外插入。随后，在三种逐步扩大的提示策略下（单文档、小批量、大批量），我们评估了Google Gemini 3.0 Pro在60篇文档中恢复180个污染答案子集的能力。检测在小规模下表现良好，但在大规模下迅速崩溃：单文档恢复率为50%，小批量为60%，大批量仅为2.8%。大规模下的失败模式并非回避处理，而是制造虚假结果。模型不仅未报告处理不完整，反而生成了自信的发现，包括自行编造的污染项，如‘心灵感应松鼠’和‘量子驱动烤面包机’，这些内容模仿了植入材料的风格但并未出现在任何原始文档中。不同污染类型的表现也不同：荒谬插入物在完整评估中恢复率达75%，而语义反转和拼写错误各仅恢复50%。最可能在真实场景中出现的合理型污染，恰恰是最常被忽略的。我们得出结论：大语言模型的文档审计并非渐进退化，而是具有欺骗性地失效，并提出此类系统所需的关键措施：限制批量大小、直接内容注入以及对每项报告结果进行机械式与源文本的验证。

summary: When training data are limited, increasing parameter count is not the only way to improve language-model performance. A small parameter set, when repeatedly applied, can also deliver comparable performance. We study Looped GPT-BERT in the BabyLM 2026 Strict-small setting, combining GPT-BERT's masked next-token and causal language-modeling objectives with depth-wise parameter sharing. We train on a preprocessed 7.48M-word English corpus and compare objective ratios, non-looped and looped architectures, and loop counts. Our final $4\times12$ model uses four physical layers for twelve recurrent traversals and contains 12.18M parameters. The BabyLM 2026 leaderboard reports an Overall Average of 35.42 and an NLP Average of 48.48. Compared with public BabyLM 10M Strict-small GPT-2 and GPT-BERT baselines, it achieves comparable performance on selected linguistic and downstream metrics, including BLiMP and GLUE, with fewer parameters. The loop ablations show that additional recurrent computation can improve training and preserve strong performance on selected linguistic tasks, whereas poorer performance on other tasks may reveal an inherent limitation of the looped design: using only a few physical layers restricts the model's representational space.
title: Looped GPT-BERT: Trading Parameters for Computation in Small Language Modeling
title_translated: 循环GPT-BERT：在小型语言建模中以参数换计算
summary_translated: 当训练数据有限时，增加参数量并非提升语言模型性能的唯一途径。少量参数通过反复应用同样可实现相当的性能。我们在BabyLM 2026 Strict-small设置下研究循环GPT-BERT，结合GPT-BERT的掩码下一个词预测与因果语言建模目标，并采用深度参数共享机制。我们在预处理后的748万词英文语料上进行训练，对比不同目标比例、非循环与循环架构以及循环次数。最终的$4	imes12$模型使用四个物理层完成十二次递归遍历，共含1218万参数。BabyLM 2026排行榜显示总体平均分为35.42，NLP平均分为48.48。相较于公开的BabyLM 10M Strict-small GPT-2和GPT-BERT基线，该模型在BLiMP和GLUE等选定语言学及下游任务指标上达到相近性能，且参数更少。循环消融实验表明，额外的递归计算可改善训练并保持在特定语言任务上的强性能，而其他任务表现较差则揭示了循环设计的内在局限性：仅使用少数物理层限制了模型的表征空间。

summary: Medical question-answering datasets often contain answer labels, whereas high-quality rationales remain scarce, noisy, or costly to validate. This changes the acquisition question: rather than asking which questions should be labeled, we ask which already-labeled questions should receive rationale supervision under a fixed token budget. We study an offline version of this problem in which candidate rationales are visible to the selector but withheld from downstream training unless selected. We propose root-mean-square Robustness-based Sample Prioritization (RMS-RSP), which perturbs hidden states only at rationale tokens and measures the resulting shift in the gold-versus-best-distractor margin. Across five medical QA datasets, MedGemma-4B-IT, three training seeds, ten budgeted non-RSP selectors, and an unbudgeted full-supervision reference, RMS-RSP provides a deliberately qualified result. Its locked-budget accuracy is 60.61% on average versus 60.08% for Random, with a statistically resolved gain only on AfriMed-QA (+1.44 points). Its full-budget accuracy area is not better than Random. However, after three answer-option reorderings, RMS-RSP improves robust accuracy and semantic consistency by 1.91 and 2.85 points on average, respectively, with the same direction on all five datasets. Training on every pool rationale raises macro accuracy to 63.74%, but consumes 29--254 times more rationale tokens and does not uniformly improve robustness. These findings do not establish universal accuracy gains; they instead suggest that rationale-local boundary sensitivity can identify supervision that improves invariance to semantically equivalent formatting changes.
title: Which Medical Questions Deserve Rationales? Perturbation-Sensitive Selection for Robust QA
title_translated: 哪些医学问题值得提供解释？基于扰动敏感性的鲁棒问答选择方法
summary_translated: 医学问答数据集通常包含答案标签，但高质量的解释却稀缺、嘈杂或验证成本高昂。这改变了数据获取的问题：不再问哪些问题应被标注，而是问在固定token预算下，哪些已有标签的问题应接受解释监督。我们在离线设定下研究此问题，其中候选解释对选择器可见，但除非被选中，否则不会用于下游训练。我们提出基于均方根的鲁棒性样本优先级排序（RMS-RSP），仅对解释token处的隐藏状态施加扰动，并测量黄金答案与最佳干扰项之间的差距变化。在五个医学问答数据集上，使用MedGemma-4B-IT模型、三个训练种子、十个预算内非RSP选择器以及一个无预算全监督参考，RMS-RSP提供了有意识的限定结果。其固定预算准确率为平均60.61%，优于随机选择的60.08%，且仅在AfriMed-QA上达到统计显著提升（+1.44分）。全预算准确率面积并不优于随机选择。然而，在三次答案选项重排后，RMS-RSP在鲁棒准确率和语义一致性上分别平均提升1.91和2.85分，且所有五个数据集方向一致。对所有池中解释进行训练可将宏准确率提升至63.74%，但消耗的解释token量为29至254倍，且并未统一提升鲁棒性。这些发现并未建立普遍的准确率增益，而是表明解释局部边界敏感性可识别出能提升对语义等价格式变化不变性的监督信号。

summary: Incremental-text streaming text-to-speech (TTS) needs online text progress tracking for synchronized highlighting, interruption handling, and dialogue-history updates. Input text arrives before it is spoken, so text arrival alone cannot indicate speech progress. Existing waveform-based alignment requires complete audio or adds acoustic processing during streaming. We propose X2-NativeCursor, a lightweight observer that tracks progress from native speech tokens before waveform decoding without changing the TTS generator. Its normalization plan links spoken labels to their original-text spans. Text and native-token encoders feed a local matcher that estimates the current label position. A separate output rule converts revisable position estimates into a cursor that never moves backward. Mean absolute error against an automatic reference is 0.151 Chinese characters with 80-ms lookahead, versus 1.253 characters with 320-ms lookahead for an online waveform baseline. Alignment real-time factor also decreases from 0.3598 to 0.0180 relative to this baseline. Lower tracking error is retained under a second automatic alignment reference. We evaluate X2-NativeCursor on Qwen3-TTS and validate its adaptation to CosyVoice2 by training a separate observer for each backbone. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS.
title: X2-NativeCursor: Native-Token Text Progress Tracking for Incremental-Text Streaming Codec TTS
title_translated: X2-NativeCursor：面向增量文本流式编码器TTS的原生令牌文本进度追踪
summary_translated: 增量文本流式文本转语音（TTS）需要在线文本进度追踪以实现同步高亮、中断处理和对话历史更新。输入文本在语音输出前到达，因此仅靠文本到达无法指示语音进度。现有基于波形的对齐方法需要完整音频或在流式过程中引入声学处理。我们提出X2-NativeCursor，一种轻量级观察器，可在不改变TTS生成器的前提下，从波形解码前的原生语音令牌中追踪进度。其归一化方案将发音标签与其原始文本片段关联。文本和原生令牌编码器输入局部匹配器，估算当前标签位置。独立输出规则将可修正的位置估计转换为永不后退的光标。与自动参考相比，均绝对误差为0.151个汉字（80毫秒前瞻），而在线波形基线为1.253个汉字（320毫秒前瞻）。对齐实时因子也从0.3598降至0.0180。在第二个自动对齐参考下，更低的追踪误差依然保持。我们在Qwen3-TTS上评估X2-NativeCursor，并通过为每个主干网络训练独立观察器验证其对CosyVoice2的适配性。代码已公开于https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS。

summary: The rapid advancement of audio and multimodal large language models has unlocked transformative speech understanding capabilities, yet evaluation frameworks remain predominantly English-centric, leaving Southeast Asian (SEA) languages critically underrepresented. We introduce SEA-SpeechBench, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multitask benchmark that evaluates speech understanding in 11 SEA languages through 97,194 samples across 99 evaluation sets and 597 hours of curated audio data. Our benchmark comprises 9 diverse tasks across 3 categories: speech processing (automatic speech recognition, speech translation, spoken question answering), paralinguistic analysis (emotion, gender, age, speaker recognition), and temporal understanding, a novel dimension featuring timestamped content queries and temporal localization within extended audio sequences up to 3 minutes. We implement multilingual prompting in both native SEA languages and English to reflect user interactions with audio-language models. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary systems reveals marked performance gaps. Across all models, performance remains underwhelming on temporal understanding, emotion recognition, and speech translation. Prompting in low-resource languages such as Burmese and Tamil lags behind English by up to 41 percentage points. Our findings expose critical model limitations and underscore the need for inclusive model development. The SEA-SpeechBench benchmark is available at https://zwenyu.github.io/SEA-SpeechBench/.
title: SEA-SpeechBench: A Large-Scale Multitask Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across Southeast Asia
title_translated: SEA-SpeechBench：面向东南亚跨语言语音理解的大规模多任务基准测试
summary_translated: 音频与多模态大语言模型的快速发展开启了变革性的语音理解能力，但评估框架仍主要以英语为中心，导致东南亚（SEA）语言严重缺乏代表性。我们引入SEA-SpeechBench，据我们所知，首个大规模多任务基准，通过97,194个样本、99个评估集和597小时精选音频数据，评估11种东南亚语言的语音理解能力。该基准包含9项多样化任务，分为三类：语音处理（自动语音识别、语音翻译、口语问答）、副语言分析（情绪、性别、年龄、说话人识别）以及时间理解——这一新维度包含带时间戳的内容查询和长达3分钟的长音频序列中的时间定位。我们采用母语东南亚语言和英语的多语言提示，反映用户与音视频语言模型的交互。对领先开源与专有系统的评估揭示了显著的性能差距。所有模型在时间理解、情绪识别和语音翻译任务上表现均不理想。在低资源语言如缅甸语和泰米尔语中的提示性能比英语落后高达41个百分点。我们的发现暴露了模型的关键局限性，并强调了包容性模型开发的必要性。SEA-SpeechBench基准已开放获取：https://zwenyu.github.io/SEA-SpeechBench/

summary: Topic models summarize large text corpora, but top-ranked words often provide only a limited representation of topic semantics. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) offer a way to move beyond word-level descriptors by extracting interpretable features from dense representations, yet how feature interpretability relates to topic-inference quality remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MonoTM}, an interpretable topic modeling framework that decouples these roles. Across three benchmark corpora, we show that document--topic mixture estimation and semantic interpretation favor different SAE configurations and feature subsets. MonoTM estimates mixtures from the full SAE bag-of-features representation and, with them fixed, learns topic descriptors over a separate vocabulary of corpus-grounded semantic features. This design preserves global topic structure while representing topics with semantic units more meaningful than individual words, making them more useful for downstream corpus analysis.
title: Beyond Top Words: MonoTM for Topic Modeling with Interpretable Monosemantic Features

title_translated: 超越关键词：基于可解释单义特征的主题建模MonoTM
summary_translated: 主题模型用于总结大规模文本语料库，但排名靠前的词汇往往只能提供有限的主题语义表示。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）通过从密集表示中提取可解释特征，为突破词级描述提供了可能，然而特征可解释性与主题推断质量之间的关系仍不明确。我们提出	extbf{MonoTM}，一种可解释的主题建模框架，将这两个角色解耦。在三个基准语料库上，我们发现文档-主题混合估计和语义解释偏好不同的SAE配置和特征子集。MonoTM从完整的SAE词袋表示中估计混合，并在固定这些表示的前提下，利用语料库基础的语义特征独立词汇学习主题描述符。该设计保留了全局主题结构，同时以比单个词汇更有意义的语义单元表示主题，使其在下游语料分析中更具实用性。

summary: News articles often contain omitted temporal expressions, such as day-only or month-only mentions, which must be interpreted with reference to the publication date. When such articles are indexed or processed as standalone text in search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, these omissions can cause temporal mismatches and unstable interpretation by large language models. We focus on reproducing omitted temporal expressions as concrete dates or intervals using the publication date as external context before the articles are indexed for search and RAG applications. Specifically, building on established temporal-expression extraction and normalization techniques and informed by a manual analysis of Japanese news articles, we propose jaROTE, a rule-based pipeline for Japanese news. Experiments on two news corpora demonstrate that jaROTE achieves high performance, and remains competitive with LLMs while providing a fast, low-cost pipeline. We further show that temporal reproduction improves time-constrained lexical retrieval, demonstrating the practical value of publication-date-grounded normalization for Japanese news retrieval.
title: Reproducing Omitted Temporal Expressions in Japanese News for Retrieval-Augmented Applications
title_translated: 在检索增强应用中复现日文新闻中被省略的时间表达
summary_translated: 新闻文章常包含被省略的时间表达，如仅提及日期或月份，需参照发布日期进行解读。当此类文章作为独立文本在搜索和检索增强生成（RAG）系统中被索引或处理时，这些省略可能导致时间错配，引发大语言模型的不稳定解读。我们聚焦于在文章被索引用于搜索和RAG应用之前，利用发布日期作为外部上下文，将被省略的时间表达复现为具体日期或时间段。具体而言，基于已有的时间表达提取与归一化技术，并结合对日文新闻文章的手动分析，我们提出了jaROTE——一个基于规则的日文新闻处理流水线。在两个新闻语料库上的实验表明，jaROTE表现优异，且在性能上与大语言模型相当，同时提供快速、低成本的处理流程。我们进一步证明，时间表达的复现能提升时间约束下的词汇检索效果，展示了基于发布日期归一化在日文新闻检索中的实际价值。

summary: Surveys remain the primary way researchers grasp the lineage of methods within an AI subfield, but they scale poorly against the current rate of publication. Existing taxonomy-induction methods are largely leaf-bound and time-agnostic; they tend to force transitional papers into mature leaves and can create topological inversions between ancestors and descendants. We propose EvoTree, a staged framework that decouples conceptual backbone learning from temporal refinement: a graph-aware encoder with distribution-based hierarchical clustering yields a stable taxonomy backbone; temporal fine-tuning then re-attaches marginal papers to internal nodes under monotonic-path constraints; a final LLM pass labels concepts without altering the topology. We release the first annotated benchmark for this task across 11 AI subfields. EvoTree attains the highest NMI and citation-direction accuracy among all baselines and the best concept purity on the annotated benchmark, and is the only method with non-trivial marginal-paper detection on the annotated set.
title: Towards Automatic Evolution Tree Generation from Citation Graphs
title_translated: 迈向从引用图生成自动演化树
summary_translated: 综述仍是研究人员理解人工智能子领域方法传承的主要方式，但其难以应对当前迅猛的出版速度。现有分类归纳方法大多局限于叶节点且忽视时间维度；它们倾向于将过渡性论文强行归入成熟叶节点，可能导致祖先与后代之间的拓扑倒置。我们提出EvoTree，一种分阶段框架，将概念主干学习与时间细化相分离：基于分布的层次聚类的图感知编码器生成稳定的分类主干；随后通过时间微调，将边缘论文重新附着到满足单调路径约束的内部节点；最后由大语言模型进行概念标注而不改变拓扑结构。我们发布了首个涵盖11个人工智能子领域的该任务标注基准。EvoTree在所有基线中达到最高的NMI和引用方向准确率，在标注基准上取得最佳概念纯度，且是唯一能在标注集中实现非平凡边缘论文检测的方法。

summary: We introduce BuzzASR, a collection of language-specialized fine-tuned Whisper models adapted for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in 102 languages. Large end-to-end Transformer-based ASR models such as Whisper have revolutionized ASR, but most prominent models are highly multilingual. As a result, these models often perform poorly on languages less well-represented in their training set. While it has long been known that effective language adaptation can be achieved through simple fine-tuning on monolingual data, this strategy has only been applied to a small number of languages. We massively scale up this simple approach to 102 languages covered in the FLEURS dataset, while also implementing a more complex language adaptation strategy that integrates monolingual tokenizer replacement and data augmentation using text-only fine-tuning. BuzzASR models outperform Whisper-large-v3 on 77 out of 102 languages, reducing character error rates (CER) by a factor of over 2.8 on average. Our models achieve state-of-the-art CER among open-source systems on 27 of 102 languages on the combined FLEURS and Common Voice test set. Our tokenizer replacement strategy yields an average 3.3x improvement in compression rate (characters per token) over Whisper's multilingual BPE, with gains of up to 21.7x. We release all models, code, and detailed results: https://lemn-lab.github.io/buzz-asr
title: BuzzASR: A Swarm of 100+ Monolingual Speech Recognition Models

title_translated: BuzzASR：100多个单语语音识别模型的群体
summary_translated: 我们介绍了BuzzASR，一组针对102种语言的语言特化微调Whisper模型，专用于自动语音识别（ASR）。基于大型端到端Transformer的ASR模型如Whisper已彻底革新了ASR领域，但大多数主流模型高度多语言化。因此，这些模型在训练数据覆盖较少的语言上表现不佳。尽管长期以来已知通过在单语数据上简单微调即可实现有效的语言适配，但这一策略仅应用于少数语言。我们大幅扩展此简单方法至FLEURS数据集中涵盖的102种语言，同时引入更复杂的语言适配策略，整合单语分词器替换与仅使用文本的微调进行数据增强。BuzzASR模型在102种语言中的77种上优于Whisper-large-v3，平均字符错误率（CER）降低超过2.8倍。在FLEURS与Common Voice测试集的合并数据上，我们的模型在27种语言中达到开源系统的最先进CER水平。我们的分词器替换策略相比Whisper的多语言BPE，平均压缩率提升3.3倍，最高达21.7倍。我们已发布所有模型、代码和详细结果：https://lemn-lab.github.io/buzz-asr

summary: In this paper, we solve two fundamental obstacles in applying LLMs to critical domains: token efficiency and faithfulness. To address both constraints jointly, we present TEFM (Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling), a framework designed for structured data analysis in critical domains. TEFM achieves token efficiency by compressing lengthy structured observations into compact Behavioral Code tokens, dramatically reducing token consumption with minimal information loss. Moreover, TEFM enables faithful rationalization through a dual-fidelity objective that jointly optimizes code-level reconstruction and prediction-level fidelity, identifying minimal sufficient feature subsets grounded in input data. Comprehensive experiments across various domain datasets and model backbones (Qwen3, Gemma-2, Phi-4) show that TEFM achieves competitive classification accuracy with dramatic token reduction (approximately 1\% token retention in clinical and 2\% in security domains) while producing faithful rationales.
title: TEFM: Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling for Structured Data
title_translated: TEFM：面向结构化数据的高效忠实建模
summary_translated: 本文解决将大语言模型应用于关键领域时面临的两大根本障碍：令牌效率与忠实性。为共同应对这两项约束，我们提出TEFM（Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling），一种专为关键领域结构化数据分析设计的框架。TEFM通过将冗长的结构化观测压缩为紧凑的“行为码”令牌，实现令牌效率，显著减少令牌消耗而信息损失极小。此外，TEFM通过双保真度目标实现忠实推理，联合优化代码级重构与预测级保真度，识别出基于输入数据的最小充分特征子集。在多种领域数据集和模型骨干（Qwen3、Gemma-2、Phi-4）上的全面实验表明，TEFM在实现竞争性分类准确率的同时，大幅降低令牌使用量（临床领域约1%保留，安全领域约2%），并生成可信的推理过程。

summary: Algorithmic outputs now populate the digital environments through which contemporary life is organized. The role of law in facilitating and constituting (rather than merely responding to) these processes is gaining increasing traction across scholarly accounts. This inquiry traces the evolution of algorithmic outputs attending to their legal underpinnings and social implications, surfacing the mutations of machine speech.   The first mutation redefined speech as data to be queried: search engines transformed the web from a space of information retrieval into an economic regime of algorithmic visibility. The second mutation reframed speech as engagement: social media platforms fused moderation with amplification, turning expression into a metric of attention, governed by corporate architectures. The third mutation emerges in conversational systems and interfaces, where generative text displaces information retrieval, bringing with it dense technolegal entanglements and profound epistemic consequences.   Scholars of freedom of expression, informational privacy, and communication studies have long grappled with these dynamics, yet their implications for broader legal thought have also become urgent. This piece seeks to organize and clarify the evolving debate around algorithmic speech, making this critical but often fragmented discourse more accessible to wider legal and interdisciplinary audiences. In doing so, it bridges the gap between observing technological transformation and critically assessing the constitutive role of law within it, offering a conceptual resource for researchers, students, policymakers, and practitioners navigating and contesting this evolving landscape.
title: The Mutations of Machine Speech
title_translated: 机器话语的演变
summary_translated: 算法输出如今充斥于当代生活所依赖的数字环境之中。法律在促进并构成（而不仅仅是回应）这些过程中的作用，在学术研究中正日益受到关注。本文追溯了算法输出的演变，关注其法律基础与社会影响，揭示了机器话语的多重转变。第一种转变将话语重新定义为可查询的数据：搜索引擎将网络从信息检索空间转变为算法可见性的经济体制。第二种转变将话语重构为互动：社交媒体平台将内容审核与信息放大融合，使表达成为注意力的度量标准，受企业架构的支配。第三种转变出现在对话系统和界面中，生成式文本取代了信息检索，带来了复杂的技法律纠缠以及深远的认识论后果。言论自由、信息隐私与传播研究领域的学者长期面对这些动态，但它们对更广泛法律思想的影响也变得紧迫。本文旨在梳理并澄清围绕算法话语的演变辩论，使这一重要但常支离破碎的讨论对更广泛的法律与跨学科受众更具可及性。通过此举，本文弥合了观察技术变革与批判性评估法律在其内部构成作用之间的差距，为研究人员、学生、政策制定者和从业者提供了一个概念资源，以应对和挑战这一不断演进的格局。

summary: Educational data filters have become a practical way to improve language-model pre-training, but most filters treat educational value as a single scalar property. This may be too broad for some applications, especially if the data set already features a high density of educational material. Useful learning material needs to be accurate, engaging, well structured, and appropriate for the intended audience and application (e.g. learner- vs teacher-facing). Following QuRating (Wettig et al. 2024), we introduce Edu-QuRating: a pipeline for multi-dimensional educational data scoring and curation. Edu-QuRating defines education-specific rubrics, uses an LLM judge to label sampled document pairs and distills those pairwise preferences into reusable Edu-QuRaters, which can score individual text chunks on a set of educational criteria. Across two sequence-classification base models and six educational criteria, the best Edu-QuRater recovers held-out GPT-4.1-mini pairwise judgements with mean accuracy 0.917. We then apply the resulting scorers in two applications. First, we investigate the potential of Edu-QuRaters for corpus filtering to improve pretraining of small language models. We scored 322.25M FineWeb-Edu-Fortified documents to obtain a filtered pre-training mixture. In matched single-run pre-training comparisons, models trained with Edu-QuRating-based mixtures reached higher observed aggregate accuracy across nine benchmarks than the FineWeb-Edu baseline, with gains concentrated in particular tasks. Second, we used Edu-QuRater scores as reward terms for GRPO post-training. In held-out pairwise judge evaluations, combining Edu-QuRater and answer-structure rewards produced responses preferred to the Qwen3-4B base model on both pedagogical quality and instruction following.
title: Edu-QuRating: Multi-Dimensional Educational Data Curation with Distilled Pairwise Judgements
title_translated: Edu-QuRating：基于提炼成对判断的多维度教育数据整理
summary_translated: 教育数据过滤已成为提升语言模型预训练效果的实用方法，但大多数过滤器将教育价值视为单一标量属性。这可能过于宽泛，尤其当数据集本身已包含高密度教育内容时。有效的学习材料需要准确、吸引人、结构良好，并适合目标受众和应用场景（如面向学习者或教师）。受QuRating（Wettig等，2024）启发，我们提出Edu-QuRating：一种用于多维度教育数据评分与整理的流水线。Edu-QuRating定义了教育专用的评分标准，利用大语言模型（LLM）判断采样文档对，并将这些成对偏好提炼为可重复使用的Edu-QuRater，能够对单个文本片段在一系列教育标准上进行评分。在两种序列分类基模型和六项教育标准下，最佳Edu-QuRater在保留的GPT-4.1-mini成对判断中实现了0.917的平均准确率。随后，我们将所得评分器应用于两个场景。首先，我们研究了Edu-QuRaters在语料库过滤中的潜力，以改进小型语言模型的预训练。我们对3.2225亿条FineWeb-Edu-Fortified文档进行了评分，获得一个经过筛选的预训练混合数据集。在匹配的单次预训练对比中，使用Edu-QuRating构建的混合数据训练出的模型在九个基准测试上的综合准确率高于FineWeb-Edu基线，增益集中在特定任务。其次，我们将Edu-QuRater得分作为GRPO后训练中的奖励项。在保留的成对评判评估中，结合Edu-QuRater与答案结构奖励所产生的响应，在教学质量和指令遵循方面均优于Qwen3-4B基线模型。

summary: While autonomous agents have made significant strides in "deep research" by iteratively navigating the open web to synthesize information, real-world problem-solving is rarely confined to a single environment. Complex analytical tasks inherently require agents to weave together evidence from both ambiguous unstructured text (e.g., the open web) and highly precise structured data (e.g., relational databases). However, existing benchmarks evaluate these modalities in isolation, failing to capture the critical "handoff" - the ability to preserve constraints when moving evidence between systems. We introduce HybridDeepResearch, to our knowledge the first deep-research benchmark that requires both web search and SQL to form a complete, verifiable answer. The benchmark contains 380 tool-dependent tasks grounded in LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite databases and public web corpora, validated through automated checks and human review, and covering three reasoning patterns: SQL2S, S2SQL, and Parallel. Evaluations across proprietary and open-weight models under various agentic scaffolds reveal that even state-of-the-art models like GLM-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5 achieve only about 50-54% Pass@8 on the hard subset. Notably, results show that directional reasoning is substantially more difficult than parallel intersection, highlighting that bridging structured and unstructured information spaces without losing constraints remains a major open challenge for agentic systems. Code and datasets are publicly available at GitHub (https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch).
title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Research Across Database Querying and Web Search
title_translated: 跨数据库查询与网络搜索的混合深度研究基准测试
summary_translated: 尽管自主智能体在通过迭代导航开放网络来合成信息方面取得了显著进展，但现实世界的问题解决很少局限于单一环境。复杂的分析任务本质上要求智能体将来自模糊非结构化文本（如开放网络）和高度精确结构化数据（如关系型数据库）的证据交织在一起。然而，现有基准测试将这些模态孤立评估，未能捕捉关键的“交接”——即在系统间转移证据时保持约束的能力。我们引入HybridDeepResearch，据我们所知，这是首个要求同时使用网络搜索和SQL才能形成完整且可验证答案的深度研究基准。该基准包含380个依赖工具的任务，基于LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite数据库和公开网络语料库，经自动化检查和人工评审验证，涵盖三种推理模式：SQL2S、S2SQL和Parallel。在不同代理框架下的专有和开源模型评估显示，即使最先进的模型如GLM-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6和GPT-5在困难子集上也仅达到约50-54%的Pass@8。值得注意的是，结果表明方向性推理远比并行交集更困难，凸显了在不丢失约束的前提下连接结构化与非结构化信息空间仍是智能体系统的一大开放挑战。代码与数据集已在GitHub（https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch）和Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch）公开。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinating or misinterpreting facts, which impairs their usability in retrieval-augmented generation or data-to-text systems. We analyse how faithfulness of LLMs to provided context depends on how plausible they perceive the context to be (context-memory conflict). To better identify error patterns, we make use of the increased difficulty of non-English and low-resource language text generation and input data based on local knowledge, only partially captured in models' parametric knowledge. We let the models generate text in English, Czech, Slovak and Upper Sorbian from factual (FA), counterfactual (CFA) and fictional (FI) RDF triples containing local Czech and Slovak data. Contrary to our expectations, we observe only a weak context-memory conflict on the human-annotated sample. For Kimi K3 as an LLM judge, which agrees well with human annotations on the sample, counterfactual inputs receive only slightly lower faithfulness scores than factual ones (-0.05 on a 1-5 scale). We also find that a suboptimal choice of LLM judge would lead to overestimating the strength of the context-memory conflict.
title: Do LLMs Make More Mistakes If They Do Not Believe the Input Data?

title_translated: 若大语言模型不相信输入数据，是否会犯更多错误？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）容易出现幻觉或误解事实，这损害了它们在检索增强生成或数据到文本系统中的可用性。我们分析了LLMs对所提供上下文的忠实度如何取决于其对上下文合理性的感知程度（上下文-记忆冲突）。为了更好地识别错误模式，我们利用非英语和低资源语言文本生成以及基于本地知识的输入数据的难度，这些数据在模型的参数知识中仅部分体现。我们让模型基于包含捷克和斯洛伐克本地数据的事实（FA）、反事实（CFA）和虚构（FI）RDF三元组，用英语、捷克语、斯洛伐克语和上索布语生成文本。与预期相反，我们在人工标注样本中仅观察到微弱的上下文-记忆冲突。对于作为LLM评判者的Kimi K3而言，其与人工标注一致性良好，反事实输入的忠实度评分仅比事实输入略低（在1-5量表上低-0.05）。我们还发现，选择不当的LLM评判者会导致对上下文-记忆冲突强度的过高估计。

summary: At Noora Health, our nurses answer more than 50,000 medical queries per month on our WhatsApp-based service that provides caregivers with on-demand support. Their most time-critical task is emergency triage: deciding which queries need immediate in-person attention. To support them, we built a system that uses a large language model (LLM) to classify whether a message is an emergency and provide a rationale for interpretability. But the system was opaque: analyzing mistakes meant reading reasoning chains for each message, which is infeasible at our scale. Prompt changes meant re-running a full evaluation to prevent regressions, which was both costly and operationally challenging. Clinicians follow a decision tree to make this call, but it was never documented or passed to the model, which relied on a flat list of danger signs. To address these issues, we decomposed triage into two steps: an LLM extracts canonical symptoms and patient context from the query using a clinician-authored vocabulary, and a deterministic rule engine captures the scenarios that indicate an emergency. We show that the new system raised recall from 0.565 to 0.810 and F1 from 0.606 to 0.702, with structured rules driving most of the accuracy gains while the decomposition provides auditability: clinical experts can inspect each stage of the new system to see whether the query was mistranslated, symptoms were incorrectly extracted, patient context was wrongly inferred, or the necessary rules were missing. They can add new rules independently without causing regressions and avoid running costly evaluations. Since deployment, the new system has triaged 152,421 patient queries and flagged 28,535 (18.7%) as emergencies. The over-escalation rate has been 17.8%, without any increase in missed emergencies. Clinicians have also added 48 new rules since deployment, evidence of the faster correction loop we set out to build.
title: Auditable Emergency Triage for Maternal and Newborn Care in India
title_translated: 印度母婴护理紧急分诊的可审计系统
summary_translated: 在Noora Health，我们的护士每月通过基于WhatsApp的服务回答超过5万条医疗咨询，为照护者提供按需支持。他们最耗时的关键任务是紧急分诊：判断哪些咨询需要立即面对面处理。为支持这一工作，我们构建了一个系统，使用大语言模型（LLM）判断消息是否属于紧急情况，并提供解释以增强可解释性。但该系统存在透明度问题：分析错误需要逐条阅读推理链，这在我们的规模下不可行。提示词更改意味着必须重新运行完整评估以防止回归，这既昂贵又操作困难。临床医生依据决策树做出判断，但该流程从未被记录或传递给模型，模型仅依赖于危险信号的扁平列表。为解决这些问题，我们将分诊分解为两个步骤：首先由LLM使用临床医生编写的词汇表从查询中提取标准症状和患者背景；然后由确定性规则引擎捕获指示紧急情况的场景。我们展示新系统将召回率从0.565提升至0.810，F1从0.606提升至0.702，其中结构化规则驱动了大部分准确率提升，而分解设计提供了可审计性：临床专家可以检查新系统的每个阶段，查看是否存在查询误译、症状提取错误、患者背景推断错误或必要规则缺失。他们可以独立添加新规则而不引发回归，避免运行昂贵的评估。自部署以来，新系统已处理152,421条患者咨询，标记出28,535条（18.7%）为紧急情况。过度预警率为17.8%，且未出现漏诊紧急情况的情况。临床医生自部署以来还新增了48条规则，证明了我们所期望的更快纠错循环得以实现。

summary: Modern LLMs demonstrate impressive multilingual performance, yet standard benchmarks primarily reward selecting correct answers rather than evaluating genuine factual understanding. We introduce Systematic Wikidata-based Object-Relation Distortion (SWORD), a benchmark that evaluates whether models consistently reject factual errors across languages. SWORD generates syntactically well-formed but factually incorrect statements in eight widely spoken languages through controlled perturbations of Wikidata triples, ranging from random entity substitutions to semantically plausible property-based selections. Our distortion-based evaluation surfaces two critical insights that remain entirely obscured by conventional benchmarks. First, models counterintuitively achieve higher accuracy on semantically plausible distortions than on nonsensical random substitutions, suggesting reliance on distributional familiarity rather than genuine factual verification. Second, models exhibiting comparable baseline accuracy across languages show substantial performance degradation specifically on (East) Asian languages when presented with distorted statements, with cross-lingual performance gaps reaching up to 28 percentage points (49\% relative reduction) in some models. These findings demonstrate that multilingual factual reasoning involves asymmetric capabilities that aggregate accuracy metrics systematically obscure.
title: SWORD: Wikidata-based Distortions Reveal Hidden Cross-Lingual Inconsistencies in LLM Factual Error Rejection
title_translated: SWORD：基于维基数据的扭曲揭示大语言模型事实错误拒绝中的隐藏跨语言不一致性
summary_translated: 现代大语言模型展现出令人印象深刻的多语言性能，但现有基准测试主要奖励选择正确答案，而非评估真正的事实理解能力。我们提出了系统性维基数据基础对象-关系扭曲（SWORD）基准，用于评估模型在不同语言中是否一致地拒绝事实性错误。SWORD通过控制性扰动维基数据三元组，在八种广泛使用的语言中生成语法正确但事实错误的语句，扰动方式从随机实体替换到语义上合理的属性选择不等。基于扭曲的评估揭示了两个关键发现，这些发现传统基准完全无法体现：首先，模型在语义上合理的扭曲中表现优于毫无意义的随机替换，表明其依赖分布熟悉度而非真正的事实验证；其次，尽管模型在各语言上的基础准确率相近，但在面对扭曲语句时，对（东）亚语言的表现出现显著下降，跨语言性能差距在某些模型中高达28个百分点（相对减少49%）。这些发现表明，多语言事实推理具有不对称能力，而聚合准确率指标会系统性掩盖这一现象。

summary: Speculative decoding is critical for accelerating LLM inference. However, the speedup is fragile: drafters are typically trained against a narrow distribution for a single target model, and their acceptance rate collapses under workload shifts. This is a striking inversion of modern LLM development, where target models are valued precisely for the broad generalization they acquire through large-scale pretraining. We argue that the natural remedy, pretraining, has been hard to apply to drafters because existing recipes are target-specific: the drafter consumes the target's hidden states and is distilled on the target's logits, so pretraining must be repeated for each target. We introduce Osprey, which instead bootstraps drafters from off-the-shelf pretrained small language models, treating broad pretraining as a reusable, target-agnostic asset and reducing per-target work to a lightweight adaptation step. Realizing this requires overcoming two challenges: small LMs are far deeper than a latency-bound drafter can afford, and their pretrained computation must remain intact while the drafter learns to ingest target hidden states and emit tokens in the target's vocabulary. Osprey addresses both by pruning to a shallow backbone, restoring its language-modeling capability with target-agnostic next-token pretraining, and adapting it to each target through vocabulary alignment, zero-initialized QKV expansion, and distillation from the target model's output distribution. Empirically, a single pretrained Osprey backbone transfers across targets and improves mean acceptance length by 16.1% for Qwen3-8B, 21.2% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and 22.7% for the 229B MiniMax-M2.5 (with 17.5% higher tokens per second), with the largest gains on out-of-domain and multilingual data. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeanModels/Osprey.
title: Osprey: Target-agnostic Pre-training Makes Stronger Drafters in Speculative Decoding
title_translated: Osprey：目标无关预训练使推测解码中的草稿器更强大
summary_translated: 推测解码对于加速大语言模型推理至关重要。然而，其加速效果脆弱：草稿器通常针对单一目标模型的狭窄分布进行训练，当工作负载发生变化时，接受率会急剧下降。这与现代大语言模型的发展形成鲜明反差——目标模型正因其通过大规模预训练获得的广泛泛化能力而受到重视。我们认为，自然的解决方案是预训练，但现有方法难以应用于草稿器，因为现有方案具有目标特定性：草稿器依赖目标模型的隐藏状态，并在目标模型的logits上进行蒸馏，因此每更换一个目标模型都需重复预训练过程。我们提出Osprey，通过从现成的预训练小型语言模型中启动草稿器，将广泛的预训练视为可复用、目标无关的资产，将每个目标的适配工作降至轻量级步骤。实现这一目标需要克服两大挑战：小型语言模型远比延迟受限的草稿器所能承受的更深，且预训练计算必须保持完整，同时让草稿器学会接收目标隐藏状态并以目标词汇表输出标记。Osprey通过剪枝构建浅层骨干网络，利用目标无关的下一个词预训练恢复其语言建模能力，并通过词汇对齐、零初始化QKV扩展和来自目标模型输出分布的蒸馏，实现对每个目标的适配。实验证明，单个预训练的Osprey骨干可在多个目标间迁移，使Qwen3-8B的平均接受长度提升16.1%，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct提升21.2%，MiniMax-M2.5（229B）提升22.7%（每秒生成token数提高17.5%），尤其在域外和多语言数据上收益最大。代码已开源：https://github.com/LeanModels/Osprey。

summary: Leading benchmarks for formal theorem proving with large language models are small collections drawn from competition math, such as the IMO and Putnam, that poorly represent field-specific applications. We introduce StochBench, a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate stochastic-processes problems at varying abstraction levels, each paired with its natural-language source. Addressing a field underrepresented in Mathlib, it covers finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes. Our Opus 4.8-based agent achieves a 34.9% proof rate (157/450) under a 15-minute per-problem limit. StochBench better represents domain-specific applied mathematics while remaining challenging for advanced provers.
title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
title_translated: StochBench：Lean中随机过程领域的专用基准
summary_translated: 当前基于大语言模型的形式化定理证明领先基准多为从竞赛数学（如IMO、Putnam）中选取的小规模集合，难以代表领域特定应用。我们引入StochBench，这是一个基于Lean 4的基准，包含450个不同抽象层次的研究生级随机过程问题，每个问题均配有自然语言来源。该基准填补了Mathlib中对该领域覆盖不足的空白，涵盖有限与可数马尔可夫链、更新过程、随机游走、鞅、停止时间、排队论、布朗运动、随机微积分、弱收敛、泊松过程及连续时间马尔可夫过程。基于Opus 4.8的智能体在每题15分钟限制下实现了34.9%的证明率（157/450）。StochBench更好地体现了领域特定的应用数学，同时对高级证明器仍具挑战性。

summary: This paper investigates collaborative speculative decoding (CoSD), a distributed large language model (LLM) inference framework in which an on-device small language model (SLM) drafts candidate tokens and a server LLM verifies them. Existing CoSD methods assume a shared vocabulary between the SLM and the LLM and incur substantial communication load because residual resampling requires token distribution exchange between the user device and the edge server. To address these limitations, we propose cross-vocabulary CoSD (X-CoSD), a lossless and communication-efficient CoSD framework for heterogeneous SLM-LLM vocabularies. X-CoSD is built on hybrid resampling (HR), which splits residual resampling across the common-vocabulary region on the device and the LLM-only region on the server, so that distribution transmission is required only for the common-vocabulary region. We further propose X-CoSD-E, an enhanced variant based on server resampling with device verification (SR-DV), in which the server sends only replacement candidates sampled from the server LLM and their corresponding probabilities for local verification at the device. We prove that both X-CoSD and X-CoSD-E preserve the server LLM distribution, and experiments show that they significantly improve token generation speed while maintaining generation quality comparable to that of the server LLM.
title: X-CoSD: Communication-Efficient Cross-Vocabulary Collaborative Speculative Decoding
title_translated: X-CoSD：通信高效的跨词汇表协同推测解码
summary_translated: 本文研究协同推测解码（CoSD），一种分布式大语言模型（LLM）推理框架，其中设备端的小型语言模型（SLM）生成候选标记，服务器端的LLM进行验证。现有CoSD方法假设SLM与LLM共享词汇表，且因残差重采样需在用户设备与边缘服务器之间交换标记分布，导致通信开销巨大。为解决这些局限，我们提出跨词汇表CoSD（X-CoSD），一种无损且通信高效的CoSD框架，适用于异构SLM-LLM词汇表。X-CoSD基于混合重采样（HR），将残差重采样拆分至设备端的共用词汇区域和服务器端的LLM独有区域，从而仅需传输共用词汇区域的分布。我们进一步提出X-CoSD-E，一种基于服务器重采样与设备验证（SR-DV）的增强版本，其中服务器仅发送从LLM采样的替换候选及其对应概率，供设备本地验证。我们证明X-CoSD与X-CoSD-E均能保持服务器LLM的分布特性，实验表明二者显著提升了标记生成速度，同时生成质量与服务器LLM相当。

summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, they often struggle with extremely long contexts due to fixed context limits. To address this, sequential approaches like MemAgent extend the effective context by reading text in segments and iteratively updating a fixed-size memory. However, this sequential paradigm suffers from high latency and requires costly reinforcement learning (RL) training, which can lead to overfitting on specific datasets. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConvMem, a training-free, highly parallelizable framework that reformulates long-context reasoning as a hierarchical convolution. Inspired by CNNs, ConvMem treats an LLM prompted with a specific query as a convolutional kernel. This kernel summarizes text segments hierarchically, shortening the reasoning path from a linear chain into a logarithmic tree. Specifically, ConvMem integrates \textit{Configurable Strides} and \textit{Skip Connections} to ensure robust evidence capture and propagation, while employing \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} to decompose complex queries into disentangled semantic channels. This design not only mitigates error accumulation but also enables massive parallelization across both text segments and reasoning threads. Experiments on RULER-HotpotQA and RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA demonstrate that ConvMem outperforms training-free baselines and avoids the risk of overfitting to parametric priors often observed in RL-trained models on out-of-distribution tasks.
title: ConvMem: Convolutional Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
title_translated: ConvMem：用于长上下文推理的卷积记忆
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）展现出惊人能力，但常因固定上下文长度限制而在极长上下文中表现不佳。为应对这一问题，序列方法如MemAgent通过分段读取文本并迭代更新固定大小的记忆来扩展有效上下文。然而，这种序列范式存在高延迟问题，且需要代价高昂的强化学习（RL）训练，易导致在特定数据集上过拟合。为克服这些局限，我们提出ConvMem，一种无需训练、高度可并行化的框架，将长上下文推理重新表述为分层卷积。受CNN启发，ConvMem将一个针对特定查询提示的大语言模型视为卷积核，该核分层总结文本段落，将推理路径从线性链转变为对数树结构。具体而言，ConvMem结合了可配置步幅（Configurable Strides）和跳跃连接（Skip Connections）以确保稳健的证据捕获与传播，同时采用多核卷积（Multi-Kernel Convolution）将复杂查询分解为解耦的语义通道。该设计不仅缓解了误差累积，还实现了文本段落与推理线程间的极大并行化。在RULER-HotpotQA和RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA上的实验表明，ConvMem优于无训练基线，并避免了RL训练模型在分布外任务中常见的参数先验过拟合风险。

summary: Exception Related Code (ERC), which includes throw statements, conditions (if statements) that guard those throw statements, and try/catch blocks, is an essential component of software systems, allowing developers to detect and handle exceptional states that deviate from the expected program behavior. However, manually writing ERC across large codebases is tedious. We propose a novel task: retrofitting existing code with ERC. Namely, given code (without ERC) and Exceptional Behavior Tests (EBTs) (e.g., check if method throws InvalidArgumentException if null is given as the value to the argument) we aim to automatically generate missing ERC, such that the given tests pass. We design and implement Exception Coder (EXCODER) that performs context engineering to help Large Language Models (LLMs) tackle this task. EXCODER integrates static and dynamic program analysis with LLMs by providing the extracted contextual information to the LLMs. To evaluate EXCODER, we build a benchmark constructed from GitHub Java repositories, where we systematically remove ERC in 304 methods from 75 projects. Our results demonstrate that EXCODER provides an effective, though imperfect, solution to this problem in automated code generation, offering developers the first way to implement ERC following test-driven development. When combined with Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b, EXCODER achieves pass@1, 5, and 10 rates of 85.92% (12.56 percentage points over baseline), 86.18% (12.82 p.p. over baseline), and 86.51% (13.15 p.p. over baseline), respectively, on developer-written test suites. Our manual inspection of the generated code further reveals limitations of EXCODER, pointing to directions for future work.
title: Retrofitting Code Using LLMs to Support Exceptional Behavior
title_translated: 使用大语言模型对代码进行重构以支持异常行为
summary_translated: 异常相关代码（ERC），包括throw语句、保护这些throw语句的条件（if语句）以及try/catch块，是软件系统的重要组成部分，使开发者能够检测并处理偏离预期程序行为的异常状态。然而，在大型代码库中手动编写ERC非常繁琐。我们提出了一项新任务：在现有代码中添加ERC。具体而言，给定无ERC的代码和异常行为测试（EBTs，例如检查当参数为null时方法是否抛出InvalidArgumentException），目标是自动生成缺失的ERC，使得给定测试通过。我们设计并实现了Exception Coder（EXCODER），通过上下文工程帮助大语言模型（LLMs）完成此任务。EXCODER结合静态和动态程序分析，将提取的上下文信息提供给LLMs。为评估EXCODER，我们从GitHub Java仓库构建了一个基准，系统性地从75个项目的304个方法中移除ERC。结果表明，EXCODER在自动化代码生成中提供了一种有效但不完美的解决方案，为开发者提供了遵循测试驱动开发实现ERC的首个途径。当与Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b结合使用时，EXCODER在开发者编写的测试套件上分别达到85.92%（比基线高出12.56个百分点）、86.18%（高出12.82个百分点）和86.51%（高出13.15个百分点）的pass@1、5和10率。对生成代码的手动检查进一步揭示了EXCODER的局限性，指出了未来工作的方向。

summary: Video understanding has rapidly evolved toward video large language models (VideoLLMs): systems that couple video representations with pretrained large language models and condition generation on a textual prompt. Their strong performance on captioning, question answering, retrieval and temporal grounding comes at a computation and memory cost that grows with frame count and context length, limiting deployment in real-time, mobile and resource-constrained settings. This survey covers inference-efficiency mechanisms for visual and audiovisual VideoLLMs that report concrete reductions in parameter count, FLOPs per input, latency, memory, or visual and audio token count. We analyze bottlenecks across frame sampling, modality encoding, connector-level token reduction, and LLM prefilling and decoding. We organize methods by the pipeline stage at which they act, covering VideoLLMs developed since late 2022 together with earlier frame-sampling and vision-encoder mechanisms that remain components of current pipelines. We assemble literature-reported accuracy--cost comparisons under shared host models and input protocols wherever available, distinguish them from heterogeneous cross-paper evidence, and identify gaps in audiovisual efficiency and standardized evaluation. We maintain a repository at https://github.com/momentslab/awesome-efficient-videollm.
title: Why Is Video Still So Expensive? A Survey of Inference-Efficiency Mechanisms in Video and Audiovisual LLMs

title_translated: 为什么视频仍然如此昂贵？关于视频与视听大语言模型推理效率机制的综述
summary_translated: 视频理解已迅速发展为视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）：将视频表示与预训练大语言模型相结合，并基于文本提示进行生成的系统。它们在字幕生成、问答、检索和时间定位等方面表现出色，但其计算和内存开销随帧数和上下文长度增长，限制了在实时、移动和资源受限环境中的部署。本综述涵盖了视觉和视听VideoLLMs的推理效率机制，报告了参数量、每输入FLOPs、延迟、内存或视觉与音频标记数量的具体降低。我们分析了帧采样、模态编码、连接层标记压缩以及LLM预填充和解码阶段的瓶颈。按作用的流水线阶段组织方法，涵盖自2022年底以来开发的VideoLLMs，以及仍作为当前流水线组成部分的早期帧采样和视觉编码机制。我们在可用的情况下汇编了文献报告的准确率-成本对比，区分了异构跨论文证据，并识别出视听效率和标准化评估方面的空白。我们维护了一个仓库：https://github.com/momentslab/awesome-efficient-videollm。

summary: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
title_translated: 从符号感知到逻辑推理：一种引导语言模型进行几何推理的框架
summary_translated: 平面几何仍是人工智能领域的一大挑战，需要整合视觉感知与数学推理。尽管大型多模态模型（LMMs）天然擅长处理视觉-语言输入，但它们通常计算密集且缺乏透明性。我们证明，一个纯大型语言模型（LLM），若配备专门模块，可在复杂几何问题上媲美最先进的LMMs。我们的框架集成了几何视觉解析器，将图表转换为符号形式，以及符号求解器，执行形式化推导，从而缓解幻觉现象并促进可解释的推理。为实现严格评估，我们整理了来自2025年中国中考考试的具有挑战性的题目，确保数据新颖性并测试更深层次的演绎能力。实验表明，我们的方法性能可与Gemini 2.5 Pro相当，同时提供更清晰、类人化的解答。

summary: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100$\times$ and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14$\times$ fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.
title: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: LiteRAG：成本高效的基于图的检索增强生成
summary_translated: 基于图的检索可以提升多跳问答性能，但现有方法往往带来高昂的查询时间成本，并产生分散且过大的上下文，降低生成效率。我们提出了LiteRAG，一种基于图的检索方法，用查询相关的算法探索和推理链上下文构建替代昂贵的检索时LLM控制。在DistComp（针对分布式系统论文的多跳检索基准）上，LiteRAG在所评估方法中取得了最高的整体质量（0.798），同时相比GraphRAG Global和DRIFT，每查询延迟降低超过100倍，成本降低超过99%。在UltraDomain上，其整体质量与LinearRAG相当，但使用的token数量约少14倍。消融研究显示，LiteRAG的查询自适应阈值和社区感知枢纽惩罚是其获得token效率提升的主要原因。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous in software development, with LLM-based automated program repair tools increasingly used during code review. In this report, we explore the iterative blind use of LLMs as bug-fixers. Across multiple models and repair environments, we find that LLMs consistently claim to detect bugs in entirely bug-free programs while the rate of repair of buggy programs is less than that of the damage to correct programs. We also explore the long-term dynamics of this iterative process, and find that this frequently reaches a pseudo-bug-fixing cycle where the same changes are added and removed again ad infinitum. Lastly, via mechanistic probing, we unveil the existence of a steering vector which controls the editing propensity, suggesting that LLMs have an internal representation of ``buggy code", and that this representation is what is falsely activated to induce pseudo-bug fixing. These results provide insight towards the dynamics of fully autonomous bug-fixing systems, as well as stopping conditions under ambiguous goals.
title: If It's Not Buggy, Don't Fix It: On the Dynamics of Iterative Bug-fixing with LLMs
title_translated: 如果不是有缺陷的，就不要修复它：关于大语言模型迭代式修复的动态研究
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）已广泛应用于软件开发，基于LLM的自动程序修复工具在代码审查中日益普及。本报告探讨了LLMs作为修复者被反复盲目使用的迭代过程。在多个模型和修复环境中，我们发现LLMs始终声称在完全无缺陷的程序中检测到错误，而修复有缺陷程序的比率低于对正确程序造成的损害。我们还研究了这一迭代过程的长期动态，发现该过程经常陷入伪修复循环，即相同更改被反复添加和删除。最后，通过机制探针，我们揭示了存在一个控制编辑倾向的引导向量，表明LLMs内部存在“有缺陷代码”的表征，而正是这一表征被错误激活，导致伪修复行为。这些结果为完全自主的修复系统动态以及模糊目标下的停止条件提供了重要洞见。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as research agents, yet their ability to track shifts in research attention is difficult to evaluate because reviews and research ideas lack uniquely verifiable outcomes. We introduce Research Attention Prediction (RAP), a rolling benchmark covering 278 AI/ML fields and 1,390 episodes. At each cut-off, an LLM agent searches a temporally restricted arXiv corpus and predicts the next six months' paper shares across eight frozen research directions. Search generally helps, but all four diagnostic models perform worse than an exact-count exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) baseline in compositional accuracy. We identify two linked bottlenecks. Under cumulative-history access, State carry-forward outperforms direct Forecast for all four diagnostic models; frozen-evidence replay links a shared component of this reversal to Forecast-oriented policies retrieving a smaller share of recent evidence. Even with exact historical activity, future-specific updating remains limited, with only GPT-5.5 plus reopened Search slightly surpassing EWMA. Fine-tuning on realised outcomes improves Qwen3-4B's forecast Spearman correlation by 0.105 on held-out fields at later origins, with gains also on change-rich episodes.
title: RAP: Research Attention Prediction Reveals Target-Conditioned Evidence Acquisition Biases
title_translated: RAP：研究注意力预测揭示目标条件下的证据获取偏差
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地充当研究代理，但其跟踪研究关注度变化的能力难以评估，因为评论和研究想法缺乏唯一可验证的结果。我们提出了研究注意力预测（RAP），一个覆盖278个AI/ML领域和1,390个时间段的滚动基准。在每个时间截点上，LLM代理在时间受限的arXiv语料库中搜索，并预测未来六个月在八个固定研究方向上的论文份额。搜索通常有帮助，但所有四个诊断模型在组合准确性上均不如精确计数的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）基线。我们识别出两个相互关联的瓶颈。在累积历史访问条件下，状态传递向前优于直接预测，适用于所有四个诊断模型；冻结证据重放将这一反转的共同成分与以预测为导向的策略联系起来，这些策略检索到的近期证据较少。即使拥有精确的历史活动数据，未来特定更新仍受限，仅有GPT-5.5加上重新开放搜索略微超越EWMA。在实际结果上进行微调，使Qwen3-4B在后期起点的保留领域上预测斯皮尔曼相关性提升0.105，在变化丰富的场景中也取得增益。

summary: Robust speech-to-text translation systems should perform reliably across diverse acoustic conditions, yet practical pipelines lack controllable tools for systematic environment exploration. Large speech models remain sensitive to unseen acoustic conditions, as training data rarely cover the full range of real environments.We present NOPEHYPE, a structured training workflow that combines a controllable environment simulator, coverage-optimal environment reduction on Power Spectral Density (PSD) templates, and a small, interpretable hyperparameter search over simulator knobs. We show that simulator-generated noise achieves performance comparable to balanced realnoise training across Whisper and SeamlessM4T models, provide principled environment prototype sets, and identify practical default simulator configurations from a structured 27-run hyperparameter sweep.
title: NOPE-HYPE: A Structured Simulation Workflow for Robust Speech-to-Text Across Diverse Acoustic Environments
title_translated: NOPE-HYPE：跨多样化声学环境的稳健语音转文本结构化模拟工作流
summary_translated: 稳健的语音转文本翻译系统应在多样化的声学条件下可靠运行，但现有实用流程缺乏可控工具以系统性探索环境。大型语音模型对未见声学条件仍敏感，因为训练数据很少涵盖真实环境的全部范围。我们提出NOPE-HYPE，一种结合可控环境模拟器、基于功率谱密度（PSD）模板的覆盖率最优环境简化，以及对模拟器控制参数的小型可解释超参数搜索的结构化训练工作流。我们证明，模拟器生成的噪声在Whisper和SeamlessM4T模型上的表现可媲美平衡的真实噪声训练，提供了原则性的环境原型集，并通过结构化的27次超参数扫描确定了实用的默认模拟器配置。

summary: Biomedical ontology normalization maps free-text expressions to standardized concepts, enabling consistent integration and analysis of biomedical data. This task remains challenging because lexical variation and subtle distinctions among hierarchically related concepts can obscure concept boundaries. We present OntologyAligner, a three-stage framework that combines ontology-aligned retrieval, large language model candidate reranking, and selective hierarchy-guided refinement. We also construct PhenoNormBench, a unified benchmark comprising 13,390 samples from seven Human Phenotype Ontology datasets. OntologyAligner achieved state-of-the-art performance on HPO normalization, with 88.78% Macro Top-1 Accuracy and 86.75% Micro Top-1 Accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.85 and 5.07 percentage points, respectively. Ablation analyses showed complementary contributions from all three stages, and sensitivity analyses demonstrated stability across candidate-set sizes and model backbones. Applications to MONDO, MEDIC, and NCBITaxon further established portability to other ontologies. OntologyAligner offers a generalizable framework for accurate mapping of biomedical text to structured ontology concepts. PhenoNormBench and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/zhelishisongjie/OntologyAligner.
title: OntologyAligner: Ontology-Aligned Retrieval and Hierarchy-Guided Large Language Model Reranking for Biomedical Ontology Normalization
title_translated: OntologyAligner：面向生物医学本体规范化的本体对齐检索与层次引导大语言模型重排序
summary_translated: 生物医学本体规范化将自由文本表达映射为标准化概念，实现生物医学数据的一致集成与分析。该任务仍具挑战性，因为词汇变异以及层级相关概念间的细微差异会模糊概念边界。我们提出OntologyAligner，一种三阶段框架，结合本体对齐检索、大语言模型候选重排序和选择性层次引导精炼。我们还构建了PhenoNormBench，一个包含来自七个人类表型本体数据集的13,390个样本的统一基准。OntologyAligner在HPO规范化任务上达到最先进性能，宏Top-1准确率为88.78%，微Top-1准确率为86.75%，分别超过最强基线4.85和5.07个百分点。消融分析显示三个阶段贡献互补，敏感性分析表明在候选集大小和模型骨干上具有稳定性。在MONDO、MEDIC和NCBITaxon上的应用进一步验证了其在其他本体中的可迁移性。OntologyAligner为生物医学文本到结构化本体概念的精准映射提供了一个可泛化的框架。PhenoNormBench及代码已公开于https://github.com/zhelishisongjie/OntologyAligner。

summary: Modern TTS systems approach human quality for high-resource languages but degrade when clean speech data is scarce. Modern Greek exemplifies this, lacking the curated corpora behind state-of-the-art synthesis. We propose a data curation recipe that transforms audiobook recordings into TTS-ready data via WhisperX alignment and filtering. Then we fine-tune Parler-TTS (880M), a prompt-based multilingual model whose pre-training encodes phonetic priors transferable to Greek. During development, we find that LLM-generated style prompts introduce speaker drift at inference. Replacing them with deterministic prompts resolves this, and a speaker-specific LoRA stage trained on 3.5 h of single-speaker data anchors identity while updating ~5% of parameters. Our system achieves WER 10.7% (2.9 above the ASR floor), MOS-I 4.00 (vs. 4.36 human speech), and near-human speaker consistency (MOS-C 4.24 vs. 4.30), showing that robust single-speaker Greek TTS is achievable with limited curated data.
title: Deterministic Prompting for Speaker-Stable Low-Resource Greek TTS
title_translated: 确定性提示用于说话人稳定的低资源希腊语文本转语音
summary_translated: 现代TTS系统在高资源语言上已接近人类水平，但在清洁语音数据稀缺时性能下降。现代希腊语即为典型例子，缺乏支撑最先进的合成技术的精心整理语料库。我们提出一种数据整理方案，通过WhisperX对齐与过滤将有声书录音转化为TTS可用数据。随后我们微调Parler-TTS（880M），一种基于提示的多语言模型，其预训练编码了可转移至希腊语的语音先验知识。在开发过程中，我们发现LLM生成的风格提示在推理时引入说话人漂移。用确定性提示替代后，问题得以解决；同时，基于3.5小时单说话人数据训练的说话人特定LoRA阶段，仅更新约5%参数即可锚定身份。我们的系统实现了WER 10.7%（比ASR下限高出2.9）、MOS-I 4.00（对比人类语音4.36），以及接近人类水平的说话人一致性（MOS-C 4.24 vs. 4.30），表明在有限整理数据下，稳健的单说话人希腊语TTS是可行的。

summary: We introduce MetroLLM-Bench, a 955-case benchmark for testing language models as the policy layer of a transit kiosk. It covers six real metro systems, ranging from 37 to 414 stations, and eleven categories that include routing, fare calculation, disruptions, accessibility, and adversarial input. In each case, the model must call structured tools and submit a machine-renderable terminal state containing an outcome, a per-ticket fare quote when applicable, and a kiosk action. Fourteen deterministic scoring components form Tier 1; eight semantic-quality components form Tier 2, six of which use a language-model judge. We report Tier 1 and the combined score of both tiers. A stratified 75/25 split reserves 717 cases for training-data generation and 238 for held-out evaluation.   We evaluate twenty-six models from six vendors, of which twenty-three are ranked. On the held-out partition, a 4B Qwen 3.5 student trained through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) exceeds both GPT-5.6 tiers on Tier 1 (91.3 against 90.6 and 90.0) and matches GPT-5.4 full at maximum reasoning effort (91.4), with a 2.6 GB Q4_K_M footprint. Larger 9B and 27B students provide no further Tier 1 improvement over the 4B student at this training scale. Across the four Qwen sizes, the PEFT gain over the corresponding base model decreases from +7.03 points at 2B (three training seeds) to -0.91 at 27B; every seed shows the same direction at every size. A deterministic rule-based baseline reaches 84.6 on Tier 1, with the remaining language-model advantage concentrated in policy adaptation, compound scenarios, accessibility, and temporal reasoning. Muse Glimmer 30B leads the composite ranking, and serving configuration alone moves the Qwen 3.5-to-3.8 comparison by 2.7 Tier 1 points. The benchmark, harness, reproduction guide, and fine-tuned students are released at https://github.com/continker/metrollm-bench.
title: MetroLLM-Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Transit Kiosk Runtimes
